thread:
maya: Quick sync — where are we on the inference tooling delivery (quant recs + batching/caching)? Need owners and next milestone for Friday rollout. TL;DR please.

arjun: Working through quant regressions. Benchmarks on fp16->q4_0 look noisy. PR #4327 has fixes; still running longshots. Failing cases mainly on rouge/loss for long seqs. ETA Wednesday for bench pass.

sam: Batching shim PR merged to staging: sam/batching-shim. Small perf win but increases tail latency in <8 token requests. Investigating dynamic batch caps. Link: https://repo/PR/4329

tj: Noted. Can we gate the Friday canary on a perf dashboard alert? If tail > 95th 20% over baseline, abort. ops-bot can we add that check?

ops-bot: deploy-checker: Added canary gate 'infer_toolkit_tail_threshold' to staging pipeline. Current status: OK. (last run: 3467890100)

arjun: Also FYI, model quant profile change requires updated kernel selection in runtime (kernel v2). I filed runtime issue #987. Need runtime team to pick kernel or fallback to q8_0.

sam: @arjun linked the PR for kernel fallback. If runtime can't pick kernel by Thursday EOD, we'll flip fallback to q8_0 in config. Pinged @tj for runtime owner.

tj: Picking up runtime issue. Quick ask: who owns the canary monitoring dashboard? Need to add token-level latency breakdown for the new batcher.

maya: Dashboard owner is @leo, cc @sara. Leo — can you add token-level breakdown and an alert for token-splitting regressions?

leo: On it. Will add a panel and set the threshold. ETA tomorrow morning. Also adding a small smoke test that runs 50 short prompts + 50 long prompts.

arjun: One blocker — some evaluation prompts are flaky due to stochastic sampling. Switched eval config to deterministic top-p for regression checks. See snippet: ```yaml
eval:
  sampling: false
  top_p: 1.0
  seed: 42
```

maya: Perfect. Last items: code reviews — arjun please ping reviewers on #4327, sam on #4329. Anyone with blockers reply here. Otherwise I'll consider this a green path to Friday canary.

tj: thumbs up :thumbsup:
